Notorious Gang Member Killed in Uttar Pradesh Encounter

A wanted gangster, Vipul alias 'Khooni', a sharp shooter for the Sushil Moach gang, was killed in a joint operation by Uttar Pradesh police and the Meerut STF in Baghpat. Vipul was wanted in 38 cases including murder, robbery, extortion, and gangster activities. Police recovered two pistols, ammunition, and a motorcycle from the encounter site.
